scope: Post-NLI01 controlled input interventions, not a holdout or source-mask repair. Same model and hypothesis template.
hypotheses: Spelling GM as Good morning will increase recognition if abbreviation interpretation caused the low original greeting score.
Removing don't from the coffee-need statement will raise the Coffee score if the classifier incorrectly lets statement polarity suppress aboutness.
Restoring a grammatical coffee sentence may remove a greeting interpretation of fragmented text; changing morning to afternoon tests time-of-day association. Neither sentence actually greets anyone.
input_policy: The separate counterfactual evidence file preserves unchanged source entries for V486/V321/V494. CF identifiers are synthetic interventions, explicitly not real notes or revised masks. No changes are made to GDC09.
interpretation: Report every score and intervention delta. Relative checks alone do not establish correct membership, calibration, or semantic parentage. The two grammatical coffee variants differ only by morning versus afternoon.
